cookie.title: Cookies & analytics
cookie.body: We use a sign-in cookie so you stay logged in, and anonymous usage data to understand how Hearth is used. We never share your family's information.

consent.title: Welcome to Hearth
consent.body: Before we get started, please review and accept the following. We're handling sensitive family information, so your acceptance is logged with the date and time for our records.
consent.termsLabel: I have read and agree to the Terms of Service.
consent.privacyLabel: I have read and agree to the Privacy Policy, including the HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices.
consent.errorRequired: Please accept both the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy to continue.
consent.errorSubmit: Something went wrong recording your acceptance. Please try again.
